properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): statuses and thread links are kept by hand, both default to `planned`, and reflow2 flags only a status that claims MORE than the design shows — never one that fell behind. And the capture guard's two routes (sharpen / distinct_from) have no "this replaces X", and distinct_from leaves no trace. So a capability rebuilt under a new node leaves its predecessor planned and its requirement pointing at it, silently.
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh from flo2), 2026-09-30, dev_reflow2 hub session, on Anthony's question "why requirement-to-capability links are outdated in places — is this reflow2 not working properly?".

① OBSERVED: on flo2's committed export (origin/main 29b569c), 37 of 88 live requirements were not fully built by a SATISFIES test. Instance: req:a-person-can-see-which-designs-they-have-from-chat was satisfied only by cap:a-person-lists-and-names-their-designs-from-chat (planned, 0 REALIZES, 0 CHANGED), yet list_my_designs is served (flo2 services/edge-gateway/src/engine-api.ts:401, mcp.ts:60).

⑤ MEASURED:
- Live hosted flo2 agrees with its export on all 15 planned/in_progress capabilities. Nothing was lost on export (C3 refuted), and it was not a stale copy (C2 refuted for flo2).
- The functions shipped under NEWER capabilities, with no edge joining old to new:
  - every-design-access-is-checked-against-membership (planned) beside the-gateway-serves-only-the-callers-designs (realized);
  - a-person-lists-and-names-their-designs-from-chat (planned) beside api-flo2-io-lists-and-starts-a-persons-designs (realized) and a-chat-model-runs-reflow2-skills-on-the-persons-designs (verified);
  - the-connector-speaks-outcomes-not-engine-tools (in_progress, amended 2026-09-23) beside the same verified capability.
  Two requirements still point only at the old node.
- All 21 of flo2's Components read `planned`, including cmp:edge-gateway, which serves production.
- detect.rs on origin/main (detect_status_contradictions, last touched 2026-09-30) still fires only on overstatement (verified without a passing check; met without SATISFIES). The mirror rule this node proposes (planned + incoming REALIZES) would NOT catch the flo2 pairs, because the old nodes have no REALIZES: the build went to a different node.
- distinct_from is consumed in-call by the capture guard (crates/reflow2-mcp/src/tools/capture.rs:1085-1118) and recorded nowhere, so whether a writer saw the older node and judged it distinct cannot be established on any design.
- The one reflow2 instance first cited (cap:edges-are-selected-by-their-declared-reading "planned") was a MEASUREMENT ERROR: it was read through the live server, whose store sits on a branch 19 commits behind origin/main (6,100 vs 6,217 nodes). Main says verified.

⑥ CLASS: something maintained by hand with nothing checking it, in the one direction nothing checks. Every instance fits: flo2's three pairs, flo2's 21 components, and this node's own 2026-08-11 instance (cap:governance-proposal served but planned).

FIXES approved by Anthony 2026-09-30 ("Yes, fixes for 1-3 should go ahead"):
(1) detect a status that claims less than the design shows, measured for flood first;
(2) give the capture guard a "this replaces X" route that moves the thread and records the choice, including distinct_from;
(3) reconcile flo2's design after (1), with the detector firing on today's flo2 export as the failing-first test.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the newer flo2 capabilities' writers were shown the older ones; whether flo2's other 11 planned capabilities are pending or abandoned; the flood size of (1) on older designs; StoryFlow and other designs not measured.

CORRECTION 2026-09-30, later the same day, from fix (3)'s evidence (flo2 chg:the-design-catches-up-with-what-flo2-built-2026-09-30; data in the hub session's flo2-reconcile.json). Of the three flo2 "pairs" above, only ONE was a supersession.
- cap:every-design-access-is-checked-against-membership was genuinely superseded by cap:the-gateway-serves-only-the-callers-designs. It is now retired, with EVOLVES_INTO the successor.
- cap:a-person-lists-and-names-their-designs-from-chat was built EXACTLY as written: list_my_designs plus the `design` argument, shipped 2026-09-23 inside another capability's change. It was simply never moved off `planned`. The capability named above as its successor is api.flo2.io's account address, a different door.
- cap:the-connector-speaks-outcomes-not-engine-tools still has a live part (read_my_design_back is recorded nowhere else) and was kept.

So the flo2 evidence for the CAPTURE half of the cause (the guard has no "replaces" route) rests on one instance, not three. The UNDERSTATED-STATUS half is strengthened: two of the three were a status nobody moved. The class statement stands.

A THIRD, related defect was found by fix (3): owner_claims_built (crates/reflow2-core/src/detect.rs:3992, origin/main) treats ANY realized/verified Component as proof that every Capability allocated to it is built. It never reads the Capability's own status. So moving flo2's components to their true `realized` status silenced unrealized_capability on three still-planned, unbuilt capabilities (a-designs-home-is-recorded-and-any-node-can-resolve-it, design-changes-reach-durable-storage-as-they-happen, make-a-design-public). This is the mirror of this finding: structure is trusted over an explicit status, in the overclaiming direction. Precedent to read: fact:the-build-list-is-suppressed-by-realized-via-component (2026-08-14). Not yet root-caused; recorded as observed.
